responsibility: Implements the x86 AVXVNNIINT8 intrinsic header for 128-bit and 256-bit int8 dot-product accumulate operations. It exposes wrappers for signed, unsigned, and saturating mixed-sign variants such as dpbssd/dpbssds/dpbsud/dpbsuds/dpbuud/dpbuuds, providing GCC’s public API for the AVX-VNNI-INT8 extension distinct from the more general AVX-VNNI and AVX-512 VNNI headers.
